messages:
marta: Following up on P-340 postmortem (recurring eviction spikes). We agreed we need owners, short timelines, and playbook updates — but also want a small automation to reduce manual paging for known patterns. Link: https://redwood.internal/pm/p-340

ryan: I can own the automation piece (small lambda that silences noisy alerts and creates follow-up ticket if pattern repeats). Plan: prototype by Wed, PR Thur, deploy to staging Fri. Will coordinate with Keisha on alert thresholds.

keisha: I'll own runbook + playbook edits. I want to add a condensed 4-step first-responder checklist, exact commands (kubectl + promtool), and an "if-this-then-that" escalation flow. Target PR by Thu AM.

runbook-bot: Existing playbook: https://playbooks.redwood/cache-eviction (v2). Suggested section: "P-340 addendum" - draft available.

marta: For automation: what inputs do you need, Ryan?

ryan: Need metric name, baseline, severity multipliers, and the API endpoint to create follow-up tickets. Also need the canonical rollback command for quick mitigation. Proposal: metric=cache_eviction_rate, WARN=2x, PAGE=5x, repeat-window=14d, repeat-count=3 -> auto-ticket.

keisha: Rollback command to include in runbook:

```bash
# revert to last known good config
kubectl apply -f gitops/cache-configs/previous-good.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-cache
```

keisha: Triage commands to paste into playbook (short):

```bash
# show eviction metric (promtool or grep)
promtool query instant "avg_over_time(cache_eviction_rate[5m])"
# quick pod-level check
kubectl logs -l app=kv-cache -c cache --tail=200 | grep -i eviction
```

pagerduty-bot: Current escalation policy: P1 -> 3m ack -> escalate to SRE -> 10m escalate to Dedicated Capacity -> 20m escalate to Eng Infra.

marta: Good. Add explicit "fallback" step: if tail_latency > 550ms for 2m, switch routing to `redwood-small` and notify product SL. Include exact route command (example below).

keisha: Routing snippet to add:

```bash
# switch to fallback model variant
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routing/swap -d '{"route":"/generate","model":"redwood-small","duration":"15m"}'
```

ryan: For the automation prototype I'll create two features: 1) silence noisy WARN alerts for 10m when mitigation applied; 2) detect the 3x-in-14d pattern and create INC ticket + assign owners. Will open PR with README and tests.

marta: Owners & deadlines summary:
- ryan: automation prototype (Wed), PR Thu, staging Fri
- keisha: runbook & playbook edits (PR Thu AM)
- marta: coordinate validation + schedule follow-up sync (weekly until closed)

ops-bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-5012 (owners: ryan, keisha) - please add PR links when ready.

keisha: One more: add monitoring policy text: WARN posts to #incidents, SEV pages SRE + Dedicated; if SEV occurs 3x in 14d auto-create follow-up ticket and add to Ops retro agenda. I'll include exact prom alert rule in my PR.

marta: Sounds good. React with :white_check_mark: to accept and I'll close once PR links are posted.
